description: This file defines the FeaturePropertiesDeleted class, representing an event emitted after a feature's properties are deleted in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality and string representation.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesDeleted
classes.description: Represents an event signaling that a feature's properties were deleted in the Eclipse Ditto system, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and helper methods.

methods.name: getFeatureId
